evidence.note: Hand reaches the closed entry-area closet door handle.
Closet door is open, exposing hanging clothes and shoes.
Closet remains open.
Hand pulls the door toward the closed position.
Closet door is fully closed.
Hand grasps the closed microwave handle.
Microwave door has swung open.
Microwave remains open.
Hand pushes the microwave door closed.
Microwave door is fully closed.
Hand begins pulling the oven handle downward.
Oven door is open and the illuminated interior is visible.
Oven door is being raised toward the frame.
Oven door is closed.
Hand approaches the dishwasher handle while the door is closed.
Dishwasher door is open, exposing the racks.
Dishwasher remains open.
Hand lifts the door into its closed position.
Dishwasher is fully closed.
Hand reaches the seam of the closed upper cabinet above the sink.
A cabinet leaf is swinging open and the shelves become visible.
Upper cabinet is open with stored items visible.
Cabinet remains open with both leaves visible.
Cabinet has just been returned to the closed state; hand remains nearby.
Hand pulls the lower kitchen drawer beside the refrigerator.
Drawer is extended with wraps and bags visible.
Drawer remains extended.
Drawer is fully shut.
Hand grasps the upper refrigerator-door handle.
Upper refrigerator door is open and its interior light is on.
Refrigerator remains open.
Hand swings the upper refrigerator door shut.
Upper refrigerator door is fully closed.
Hand grasps the lower freezer-door handle.
Lower freezer door is open, exposing freezer drawers.
Freezer remains open.
Hand pushes the lower freezer door inward.
Lower freezer door is fully closed.
Laundry-closet door is closed.
Door has opened, revealing the stacked washer and dryer.
Laundry closet remains open.
Hand pulls the door toward the jamb.
Laundry-closet door is fully closed.

notes: Nine localized state-change episodes are visible. The upper cabinet is treated as one double-door cabinet episode because both leaves are manipulated within the same continuous approach and no disengagement separates them.
scene_description: A person surveys a studio apartment and then sequentially opens and closes a clothes closet, microwave, oven, dishwasher, upper cabinet, drawer, refrigerator, freezer, and laundry closet.
